site.title: Ankole
site.description: Ankole is the open source Agent Harness with a Company Brain, and an alternative to Claude Tag. Its Agents do ongoing work for your company in the chat tools your people already use.
hero.badge: Open source · Runs on your infrastructure · From one-person company to enterprise
hero.subtitle: Ankole runs AI Agents that do ongoing work for your company. The Agents share a Company Brain that remembers what your team decided. Your people ask them in the chat tools they already use, such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, Lark, DingTalk, and WeCom. An open source alternative to Claude Tag.
hero.claim.recovery: Long tasks survive crashes and restarts
hero.claim.noLockIn: Not tied to Slack or to Claude models
hero.claim.access: Each Agent works within the access you grant
thread.aria: A group chat shows how Ankole captures a company rule nobody explicitly taught it and applies that rule to a later decision.
thread.h1.author: Ravi
thread.h1.text: for cyclical stocks, use data from a full cycle; three years is too short
thread.h2.author: Mia
thread.note: Ankole captured a company rule nobody explicitly taught it
thread.h3.author: Sam
thread.h3.text: @Ankole run a valuation on the metals stocks
thread.reply: On it. Using seven years of data for the cyclical stocks, as this channel agreed three days ago.

difference.title: A model with a prompt and a few tools starts every task from zero
difference.subtitle: It does not know what your team decided last week, it acts with whatever access it holds, and its work ends when its process dies. The harness around the model fills these gaps.
difference.function.title: Agents remember what the company decided
difference.function.body: Company Brain learns from conversations, registered files and URLs, and notes that Agents write. Each piece of knowledge keeps its source and date. New evidence updates the current view and keeps the history.
difference.outcome.title: Corrections and outcomes feed later work
difference.outcome.body: After repeated corrections, an Agent can propose a Skill lesson, a short rule that takes effect when a person approves it. Company Brain records forecasts. When one comes due, it compares the forecast with what actually happened.
difference.loop.title: Work starts when something happens
difference.loop.body: A message, a schedule, a webhook, or another external event wakes the Agent that owns the work. An Agent can also set a reminder to check back later.
difference.context.title: Long work survives failures
difference.context.body: A task can run for hours or days and accept new input while it runs. A crash affects only the conversation where it happened. PostgreSQL keeps the inputs, model history, and tool results that Ankole needs to continue the work.
difference.governance.title: Each Agent works within the access you grant
difference.governance.body: People and Agents each have an identity and permissions, and Agents share no computer, home directory, or credential. Offboarding a person blocks their sign-in and stops the tasks and schedules they own.
compounding.title: Nobody asked Ankole to remember the seven-year rule
compounding.body: Company Brain learned it from a chat that Ankole belongs to, kept its source and date, and applied it to the next request that needed it. Every authorized Agent uses the same current company knowledge.
compounding.ledger.title: Company Brain · Research rules
compounding.r1.rule: Cyclical stocks use percentiles from seven years of data
compounding.r1.from: Agreed in a conversation between two colleagues
compounding.r2.rule: Lead with the conclusion and include the risks
compounding.r3.rule: State when data is missing and use only observed values
compounding.r3.from: Written into the skill after an incident
compounding.r4.rule: Value the HK listing separately from the A share listing
compounding.log.p1: A vector database stores messages and retrieves fragments by similarity. It can return an old rule beside the rule that replaced it.
compounding.log.p2: Company Brain stores each rule as a claim with its source, time, confidence, audience, and holder: the person or Agent whose view it is. New evidence updates the current view and keeps the history. Conflicting claims stay visible for review.
compounding.log.p3: The next request starts from what the company knows today. Repeated corrections can sharpen a rule, and a forecast stays linked to the outcome that tests it.
compounding.proof.title: Ankole tests Company Brain on its own codebase
compounding.proof.body: An Ankole Agent helps maintain this repository with the same Company Brain, tools, and work rules that a company gets. Corrections and results update the context and procedures for later maintenance.
capabilities.title: Built for ongoing company work
capabilities.subtitle: Ankole is a complete system, not a library. It brings its own control plane, database, and Agent computers.
capabilities.async.title: The work keeps running
capabilities.async.body: Long research, scheduled checks, and later reviews continue outside the chat. After a crash, the same work resumes from the state that PostgreSQL kept.
capabilities.tacit.title: Agents learn what your team never wrote down
capabilities.tacit.body: Company Brain learns rules, preferences, and rejected options from conversations, registered files and URLs, and notes that Agents write.
capabilities.brain.title: Company Brain shows each person only what they may see
capabilities.brain.body: Before the model reads company knowledge, Company Brain removes what the person asking may not see. In a group chat, it can apply the permissions of every member.
capabilities.research.title: Deep Research tests competing hypotheses
capabilities.research.body: Deep Research gathers evidence in several separate contexts, tests competing hypotheses, and returns a cited report.
capabilities.browser.title: Each Agent has its own computer
capabilities.browser.body: A Linux container gives the Agent a browser, a terminal, files, Codex, MCP servers, and Skills. Its home directory survives restarts and upgrades.
capabilities.skills.title: Repeated corrections become Skill lessons
capabilities.skills.body: A Skill is an approved procedure for one kind of work. After repeated corrections, an Agent can propose a Skill lesson, a short rule for that Skill. It takes effect when a person approves it.
capabilities.multi.title: Separate contexts make shared mistakes less likely
capabilities.multi.body: Workflow splits one question across several Agents. Each works in its own context. Workflow checks their structured results and combines them.
capabilities.enterprise.title: Every request, model call, and delivery is on record
capabilities.enterprise.body: PostgreSQL records what each Agent was asked, which model calls it made, and what it delivered. Token quotas cap the model spend of each Agent.
usecases.title: What people ask Ankole to do
usecases.subtitle: These requests arrive in a group chat or a direct message.
usecases.digest.title: Send a weekly digest
usecases.digest.action: Sets a weekly schedule. Each week it reads the nine accounts on X that you named, groups the posts by topic, and writes the PDF.
usecases.digest.result: A PDF in the channel every Friday at 17:00
usecases.issue.title: Fix an issue
usecases.issue.action: Runs Codex in a background job with the repository credentials that an administrator configured.
usecases.issue.result: A pull request in your repository
usecases.summary.title: Sum up the week
usecases.summary.action: Reads the channel history that it has permission to see, then lists the open action items.
usecases.summary.result: A summary and a list of action items
usecases.files.title: Make slides or translate a file
usecases.files.action: Turns a paragraph into a slide deck, or a PDF into another language.
usecases.files.result: A PowerPoint file or the translated PDF
usecases.rumor.title: Check a rumor
usecases.rumor.action: Runs Deep Research on the claim and weighs the evidence on both sides.
usecases.rumor.result: A cited brief with the evidence for and against
usecases.index.title: Rebuild an index
usecases.index.action: Gets the data and computes the index from its published rules in a Jupyter notebook.
usecases.index.result: A chart of the index against the official values
usecases.quote: Fluent prose is cheap. Every request ends in work you can check.
bets.title: Enterprise work survives process failure
bets.subtitle: Actor identities, isolated failure domains, live control, replaceable execution, and PostgreSQL keep work recoverable when a process crashes.
bets.actors.title: Each Session keeps its identity across process restarts
bets.actors.body: Every active Session is a Virtual Actor with an address, state, mailbox, lifecycle, and recovery position.
bets.otp.title: Failures stay local
bets.otp.body: OTP supervision trees isolate an execution branch that hangs, times out, or crashes. Ankole reconstructs that work from durable state while other work continues.
bets.fabric.title: Live control reaches running Agents
bets.fabric.body: One Phoenix Channel per Worker carries environment tools, Codex Job control, checkpoints, and backpressure. The control plane runs the main conversation loop.
bets.computer.title: Every Agent has a work computer
bets.computer.body: Agent Computer runs environment tools, Codex Jobs, Automation Jobs, browsers, files, terminals, and scripts. Its local state can be rebuilt. PostgreSQL keeps committed domain facts.
bets.ledger.title: Committed work survives process failure
bets.ledger.body: PostgreSQL keeps messages, turns, reminders, decisions, delivery state, and committed actions. Streaming reports progress. The stored record identifies completed work.
quickstart.title: Run the full Harness
quickstart.subtitle: Start on one Linux, macOS, or Windows host with Docker Compose, deploy on Kubernetes, or run directly from source.
quickstart.tabs.docker: Docker Compose · Recommended for one host
quickstart.source.note: Get the toolchains ready with the installer in the repository, then start the full development environment with bun dev.
quickstart.docker.note: Run this Compose stack on Linux, macOS, or Windows wherever Docker can run Linux containers. It includes PostgreSQL, the control plane, and Caddy HTTPS; the control plane creates one Worker container for each Agent.
quickstart.k8s.body: The public Helm chart deploys the verified image pair and bundled or external PostgreSQL, and keeps Agent drives on a volume or in S3. The control plane creates one Worker Pod for each Agent.
cta.title: Give your company a Brain
cta.body: Run Ankole on infrastructure you control. Company context stays on your servers. Model and search calls go only to the providers you configure.
